sources.title: Indira Nagar metro station (Bengaluru)
sources.usageNote: Article text and infobox facts only (CC BY-SA 4.0) — opening date, structure type, entrance count/labels. No photographs viewed or reproduced from this or any other source.

referenceNotes: Supported by the source: elevated structure on the Purple Line's east-west corridor, CMH Road / 100 Feet Road location, opened 20 October 2011 as one of the first six stations, three entry/exit points (A/B/C toward Raghavendra Swamy Mutt and ESI Hospital), side-platform arrangement (2 platforms, 2 tracks).

NOT supported by any source consulted, and therefore not claimed as accurate: exact roof/canopy form, column spacing, materials, paint scheme, or entrance canopy design. These are architecturally reasonable estimations consistent with early-phase Namma Metro elevated stations, not verified detail.

Renderer limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: the shared platform layout engine only builds island platforms, so this station's real side-platform arrangement is approximated as a single island module.
No image files were downloaded, scraped, or embedded — this dataset stores link-only pointers to publicly viewable pages, gathered by reading their text content.
